title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 20: Jehoshaphat's prayer, the battle that was God's, and the end of his reign.

questions.text: What other name does the text give for Hazazon Tamar?
questions.explanation: Jehoshaphat was told the great multitude was in Hazazon Tamar, "that is, En Gedi."

questions.text: What did Jehoshaphat proclaim throughout all Judah when he was alarmed?
questions.explanation: Jehoshaphat set himself to seek Yahweh and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

answers.text: A day of rest from work

questions.text: How did Jehoshaphat end his prayer: "We don't know what to do, but..."?
questions.explanation: Jehoshaphat ended his prayer with, "We don't know what to do, but our eyes are on you."

answers.text: We will flee to the mountains
We will send to the king of Syria
We will make peace with them

questions.text: On whom did Yahweh's Spirit come in the middle of the assembly?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's Spirit came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, in the middle of the assembly.

questions.text: What did Jahaziel say about the battle?
questions.explanation: Jahaziel said, "Don't be afraid, and don't be dismayed because of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's."

answers.text: The battle will last seven days
The battle is not yours, but God's
The battle must be fought at night

questions.text: Into which wilderness did the people go out early in the morning?
questions.explanation: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa.

questions.text: What did Yahweh do when the singers began to sing and to praise?
questions.explanation: When they began to sing and to praise, Yahweh set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir.

answers.text: He set ambushers against the enemies
He opened the earth beneath them
He sent a plague into their camp

questions.text: For how long did Jehoshaphat and his people take plunder?
questions.explanation: They found so much that they took plunder for three days.

questions.text: What was the place called where they assembled on the fourth day to bless Yahweh?
questions.explanation: On the fourth day they assembled in Beracah Valley, for there they blessed Yahweh, so the place was called "Beracah Valley."

questions.text: With which king of Israel did Jehoshaphat join himself to make ships to go to Tarshish?
questions.explanation: Jehoshaphat joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel to make ships to go to Tarshish; the ships were wrecked.
